title: 第818章 伸手讨要什么你的我的第817章 熟人相见来自晓组织的刺杀
content_zh:
“我以天枢阁的名义担保。令狐少爷大可放心，就算是我死了，他们二位都不会有任何事。”薛听雨笑了一下，目光没有看向令狐黎，而是落在他身后那两道平静的身影上。
令狐黎顺着她的目光回头看了炎君和女帝一眼，确认两人脸上的神色并未因薛听雨的话而出现任何变化。
他转回来，点了点头：“好。”
他侧过头，对炎君和女帝说，“昱炎、玥安，你们在这里等我回来。”
“好，你自己当心。”炎君点点头。
他走出雅间，关上门的动作很轻。
薛听雨站在桌边，目光落在杯沿上：“现在这里没有外人了。你们还要继续演下去吗？”
她回过头，看向两人，“天照剑，炎狱枪。我不可能认错。”
她说着，在桌边坐下，手指轻轻叩了一下桌面。
“好久不见呐，听雨。”女帝笑着坐着，自顾自的给自己倒了杯茶水，动作自然。
“终于遇见放心的熟人了。”炎君也更是毫不客气，直接坐在了桌沿上。
薛听雨的小嘴微微张开，目光在两人脸上来回移动，像是在确认自己刚才没有产生幻觉。
“真的是你们？你们......复活了？！”
“如假包换。”女帝端起茶杯抿了一口。
“千真万确。”炎君补充道。
薛听雨的目光在二人身上扫了一遍又一遍，“所以到底发生什么事了？”
女帝撑着头摇了摇：“我们也不清楚。醒来的时候，躺在一片平原上，身上什么都没有。
修为全无，记忆还在。不知道是谁把我们放在那儿的，也不知道为什么我们会复活。”
“那武器呢？”薛听雨追问，“武器不是跟你们一起躺在平原上的吧？”
“不是。它们是后来自己飞过来的。”女帝的语气平静，“炎狱枪和渊龙盾是先后到的，天照剑和大天使权杖也是。

四柄武器自己找上门来，我们没有主动召唤过，也不知道它们是怎么找到我们的。”
她停顿了一下，“可能是跟我们复活的原因有关，但具体是什么，我们还没弄清楚。”
薛听雨沉默了片刻，她把目光移向炎君：“你们的哥哥们知道这件事吗？”
炎君被女帝从桌上推下来，后退了半步站稳，拍了拍衣袍：“他们肯定已经知道了。四柄神级武器消失，他们不可能没有察觉。
他们没来找我们，说明他不想打扰我们现在的状态。”炎君说着，语气里带着一层淡淡的确定的意味。
“你们哥哥不要你们咯。”薛听雨不禁打趣道，嘴角微微扬起，带着一种重逢后才会露出的轻松弧度。
炎君、女帝：？
“这么久不见，给点好东西来。”炎君站在薛听雨面前，伸出手，掌心朝上，理直气壮。
“以前怎么没发现你跟你哥哥一个德性？”薛听雨看着面前的炎君，目光在他脸上停留了一瞬，感觉面前站的就是邪帝。
“有其哥必有其弟呗。”女帝喝了一口茶水，语气随意。
content_en:
"I guarantee it in the name of Tianshu Pavilion. Young Master Linghu can rest assured that even if I die, nothing will happen to the two of them." Xue Tingyu smiled, and his eyes did not look at Linghu Li, but fell on the two calm figures behind him.
Linghu Li followed her gaze and glanced back at Yan Jun and the Empress, confirming that the expressions on their faces had not changed in any way due to Xue Tingyu's words.
He turned back and nodded: "Okay."
He turned his head and said to Lord Yan and the Empress, "Yu Yan, Yue'an, wait here for me to come back."
"Okay, be careful." Yan Jun nodded.
He walked out of the private room and closed the door very gently.
Xue Tingyu stood by the table, her eyes falling on the rim of the glass: "There are no outsiders here now. Do you want to continue the show?"
She turned back and looked at the two of them, "Amaterasu Sword, Flame Prison Spear. It's impossible for me to admit my mistake."
She said, sitting down at the table and tapping her fingers lightly on the table.
"Long time no see, Ting Yu." The empress sat with a smile and poured herself a cup of tea, her movements natural.
"Finally, I met an acquaintance whom I feel relieved about." Yan Jun was even more unceremonious and sat directly on the edge of the table.
Xue Tingyu's little mouth opened slightly, and her eyes moved back and forth on the two people's faces, as if to confirm that she had not hallucinated just now.
"Is it really you? Are you...resurrected?!"
"It's true." The empress picked up the tea cup and took a sip.
"It's absolutely true." Yan Jun added.
Xue Tingyu glanced at the two of them over and over again, "So what happened?"
The empress held her head and shook her head: "We don't know. When I woke up, I was lying on a plain with nothing on me.
There is no cultivation, but the memory is still there. No idea who put us there or why we were resurrected. "
"What about the weapons?" Xue Tingyu asked, "The weapons were lying on the plain with you, right?"
"No. They flew over by themselves later." The empress' tone was calm, "The Flame Hell Spear and the Abyssal Dragon Shield arrived one after another, as did the Amaterasu Sword and the Archangel Scepter.
The four weapons came to us on their own. We didn't actively summon them, and we don't know how they found us. "
She paused, "It may be related to the reason for our resurrection, but we haven't figured out what it is specifically."
Xue Tingyu was silent for a moment, then she turned her gaze to Yan Jun: "Do your brothers know about this?"
Yanjun was pushed off the table by the Empress, took half a step back to stand still, and patted his robe: "They must have known about it. There is no way they could not have noticed the disappearance of the four god-level weapons.
They didn't come to us, which means they don't want to disturb our current situation. Yan Jun said, with a hint of certainty in his tone.
"Your brother doesn't want you." Xue Tingyu couldn't help but joke, the corners of his mouth slightly raised, with a relaxed arc that would only be revealed after a reunion.
Yanjun, Empress:?
"It's been so long since we last saw each other, give me something good." Yan Jun stood in front of Xue Tingyu, stretched out his hand, palm facing up, confidently.
"Why didn't I realize that you and your brother have the same virtue before?" Xue Tingyu looked at Lord Yan in front of him, her eyes lingered on his face for a moment, and she felt that the person standing in front of her was the Evil Emperor.
"Like brother, like brother." The empress took a sip of tea and spoke casually.
